_meta.description: Deterministic follow-up protocol. These are PROTOCOL actions retrieved from a curated table, not model output - the UI labels them as such so a clinician can tell them apart from AI-suggested next steps.
_meta.disclaimer: Decision-support only. Does not replace clinical judgement or local escalation policy.
